title.en: Chapter 5 — The Beetle and the Dog

sentences.en: At church, the sermon was long and dull.
Tom opened a small box he had with him.
A beetle came out of it and fell on the floor.
A small dog came in and saw it.

sentences.ar: الكلب لعب فيها لحد ما قرصته.
sentences.en: The dog played with it until it bit him.
He ran and yelped between the chairs.
The people could not stop laughing.
